(ruling)
[ii 1'] [I will annihilate] whatever enemies you [have]. As for [you, stay] in your palace; I will [reconcile] Assyria with you. I will protect [you] by day and by dawn and [consolidate] your crown.
[ii 6'] Like a winged bird ov[er its young] I will twitter over you and go in circles around you. Like a beautiful (lion) cub I will run about in your palace and sniff out your enemies.
[ii 11'] I will keep you safe in your palace; I will make you overcome anxiety and trembling. Your son and grandson shall rule as kings before Ninurta.
[ii 15'] I will abolish the frontiers of all the lands and give them to you.
[ii 17'] Mankind is deceitful; I am one who says and does. I will sniff out, catch and give you the 'noisy daughter.'
[ii 21'] As for you, praise me! Gather into your innards these words of mine from Arbela:
[ii 24'] The gods of Esaggil languish in the 'steppe' of mixed evil. Quickly let two burnt offerings be sent out to their presence, and let them go and announce your well-being!
[ii 28'] From the mouth of La-dagil-ili of Arbela.
(ruling)[ii 29']Thus shall you answer the disloyal ones! [ii 30']The word of Ištar of Arbela, the word of Queen Mullissu: [ii 31']I will look, I will listen, I will search out the disloyal ones, and I will put them into the hands of my king.[ii 34']I will speak to the multi[tudes]: [ii 35']Listen, sunr[ise] and sunset! [iii 16'] Who (then) is the lone man? Who is the wronged man? Have no fear! Well sheltered is Esarhaddon, king of Assyria.
[iii 18'] From the mouth of the woman Urkittu-šarrat of Calah.
(ruling)
[iii 19'] Esarhaddon, have no fear! I will put Assyria in order and reconcile the angry gods with Assyria.
[iii 21'] I will pull away the cover of your enemies and shed the blood of my king's enemies. I will protect my king; I will bring enemies in neck stocks and vassals with tribute before his feet.
[iii 26'] I am your father and mother. I raised you between my wings; I will see your success.
